g.title: Aspect ratio conversion bars, by Adam Stanislav
g.desc: Use this to convert a video shot with the HDTV 16:9 aspect ratio compromise to Prime Widescreen. To what, you say? Well, ancient Greeks loved prime numbers (a prime number, as you know, is a number that cannot be divided by any number other than 1 and itself). I happen to share that love with those ancient Greeks. So, I just made up a widescreen ratio of 19:7. And since both 19 and 7 are prime numbers, and since 19/7 = 2.71 (roughly, obviously) which is quite a wide-screen ratio, I have named it the Prime Widescreen.
